gui.lectern-enchanted-books.title: Enchanted book
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: Increases damage dealt to spiders by {damage} hearts and applies up to {maxDuration} seconds of slowness
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Once equipped, the user cannot manually unequipping this item
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Reduces damage of explosions by {reduction}% and knockback by {knockback}%
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc.le: Summons lightning bolts when thrown during thunderstorms
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc.level: Increases damage by {damage} hearts per block fallen
enchantment.minecraft.depth_strider.desc: Increases movement speed while walking underwater by {speed}%
enchantment.minecraft.efficiency.desc.le: Increases mining efficiency by {speed} (defaults: Iron 6, Diamond 8)
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc.l: Sets the target on fire for {duration} seconds
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Reduces burn time by {duration}% and damage by {damage}&
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Sets the target on fire for 5 seconds
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc.level: Multiplies the drop quantity of some blocks mined by an average of {multiplier}x
Reduces damage when walking over fire. Converts a disk of {radius} blocks of water into ice when walking on top
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc.leve: Increases damage dealt to ocean mobs by {damage} hearts
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Does not consume ammo when firing. Still requires one ammo item to fire
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc.level: Increases drop quantity of mobs by {quantity} and their rarity
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc.level: Returns after being thrown with an acceleration of {acceleration} block/s^2
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc.level-x: Applies {knockback} knockback to target, but {exhaustion} hunger exhaustion to self
enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc.level-x: Reduces the time until a catch by {duration} second(s)
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Repairs durability when in hand and gaining xp
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc.lev: Increases projectile count by {quantity} and projectile spread by {spread}°
enchantment.minecraft.protection.desc.le: Reduces damage of most sources by {reduction}%
Reduces the reload time by {duration} seconds
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc.level: When in water, the player moves with the trident when thrown. Deals {damage} heart(s)
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Allows collecting fragile versions of blocks like grass, stone or glass
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc.level-x: Increases damage dealt to undead mobs by {damage} hearts
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc.le: Increases movement speed by {speed}% when on soul blocks. Also consumes durability
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: Increases damage dealt by sweeping attacks by {increase}%
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc.level-: Applies up to {maxDamage} hearts of damage to attackers. Chance increases per level
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc.le: Adds a {increase}% chance to not use durability
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: When dying, this item is going to be destroyed
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: Applies a vertical impulse when hitting an entity during a fall
